## Award RFQ

The single writer for the RFQ → PO transition. Awards only a sent or comparing RFQ, and re-enforces both award gates (stale quote, lapsed compliance) — a quote with no linked vendor profile is refused, since compliance cannot be checked. It stamps the PO number (snapshot), computes the threshold route from the quote total (auto <$1k / Manager <$10k / Finance→VP ≥$10k), generates pending chain steps, copies the winning lines, and marks the RFQ awarded. An auto-route PO is approved immediately and committed against the budget; larger POs commit on final approval instead.

### Example

Natural target: the linked RFQ "Q1 Laptop Refresh". Acme Supply's quote can be awarded; TechSource's is cheaper but refused, because its insurance lapsed in August.

### Non-goals

No decline notifications to losing vendors. No partial awards / line splitting across vendors.
